displayName: Pull insights from research reports across my tools
summary: Synthesise key findings from reports spread across all your tools.

useCases.title: Pull insights from research reports across my tools
useCases.message: Help me extract insights from my research reports. Ask me where the files are: Google Drive, Notion, email, or uploaded PDFs. Then pull key findings across all of them and give me a structured synthesis with links back to the originals.
